job.title: Customer Success Engineer
job.description:
Who We Are

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We're curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.

Who You Are

You are technically curious, customer-focused, and get satisfaction from helping people become capable and confident users of complex technology. You may come from Customer Success, technical enablement, Developer Relations, Support, Solutions Engineering, or another customer-facing technical role.

You enjoy understanding why customers struggle with a product and turning those insights into better ways of teaching thousands of customers — not simply solving the same problem repeatedly.

You are comfortable teaching technical concepts live, creating clear educational content, and guiding customers through unfamiliar workflows. You know when to demonstrate, when to advise, and importantly when to let the customer drive the keyboard.

You look for patterns. If several customers ask the same question, your instinct is not simply to answer it again; it is to create the guide, video, workshop, workflow, or program that means the next customer can answer it themselves.

Empathetic to customer needs and the importance of communicating in remote relationships, you can provide clear and prescriptive guidance while maintaining the boundaries required for a scalable self-service customer experience.

Many Roboflowers have used our tools before joining. One of the best ways to stand out amongst other applicants is to write about something you have built with Roboflow or contribute to one of our open source projects.

We are hiring Customer Success Engineers to help our self-serve and Corporate customers become successful, independent users of Roboflow. You will have direct input on the evolution of this role, the Customer Success Engineering function, and how Roboflow enables an increasingly large community of computer vision practitioners.

If you enjoy teaching technical concepts, building programs and content, and finding scalable ways to help customers succeed, let’s have a chat.

What You’ll Do

Roboflow's product-led growth customers are building an enormous variety of computer vision applications. Customer Success powers up those customers with the technical knowledge, best practices, and structured enablement they need to expand how they use Roboflow and confidently progress from experimentation into production.

The function operates through two complementary enablement models:

  • Scalable enablement — recurring webinars, onboarding sessions, technical workshops, clinics, office hours, learning journeys, and reusable educational content designed to help large numbers of self-serve customers progress independently.

  • Targeted 1:1 enablement — structured, time-bound delivery of the Targeted Enablement Option Pack for qualifying Corporate customers who need additional guidance through core Roboflow functionality.

The objective isn't to do the customer's work for them; it is to remove educational friction and give customers the knowledge, tools, and confidence to progress independently.

You will teach customers how to work effectively with datasets, annotations, model training and evaluation, and the wider Roboflow platform. Just as importantly, you will identify recurring points of friction and turn them into programs and reusable assets that can benefit hundreds or thousands of future customers.

Role And Responsibilities

  • Develop, deliver, and continually improve technical enablement programs for Roboflow's self-serve customer base, covering platform onboarding, annotation strategy and quality, dataset management, model training and evaluation, workflows and deployments and workspace administration

  • Host bi-weekly webinars, technical workshops, office hours, and other live educational sessions

  • Develop learning journeys that guide customers towards increasingly sophisticated use of Roboflow technology

  • Deliver Roboflow's structured 1:1 Targeted Enablement Option Pack for qualifying customers

  • Create reusable technical enablement assets including documentation, videos, walkthroughs, recordings, and reference materials

  • Identify recurring customer questions and turn them into scalable educational programs or assets

  • Monitor customer activation and engagement signals to identify users and cohorts who may benefit from specific enablement programs

  • Measure participation and effectiveness of enablement programs for continual improvement

  • Collaborate with Product to identify and close recurring knowledge and usability gaps

  • Stay current with the latest Roboflow product features, releases, workflows, and recommended best practices

Technical Proficiency

  • Working knowledge of computer vision and machine learning, including datasets, annotation, model training, evaluation, and inference

  • Comfortable using Python and working with APIs, notebooks, and common developer tooling

  • Ability to become highly proficient across the Roboflow platform and demonstrate its workflows confidently to customers

  • Understanding of model evaluation concepts including precision, recall, confidence thresholds, confusion matrices, and common causes of poor model performance

  • Understanding of dataset quality, annotation strategy, dataset versioning, and approaches for identifying difficult or underrepresented examples

  • Ability to translate technical concepts into clear, practical guidance for users with varying levels of ML experience

Individual Skills

  • Technical Teaching: Able to explain unfamiliar technical concepts clearly and adapt the explanation to the customer's level of experience

  • Pattern Recognition: Recognize recurring questions and friction across customer interactions and identify opportunities to solve them systematically

  • Program Delivery: Methodical planning and delivery of structured 1:1 sessions, webinars, workshops, and other customer-facing technical programs

  • Content Creation: Able to create concise, technically accurate educational material across written, recorded, and live formats

  • Workload Management: Manage multiple customers progressing through structured enablement while balancing program delivery and reusable content creation

  • Customer Communication: Communicate clearly and professionally before, during, and after enablement engagements, setting expectations around preparation, outcomes, and next steps

Bonus Skills

  • Experience using the Roboflow platform or contributing to the Roboflow ecosystem

  • Previous experience in Customer Success, technical enablement, Developer Relations, technical education, Solutions Engineering, or technical Support

  • Experience creating technical educational content such as tutorials, videos, workshops, documentation, or developer courses

  • Experience delivering webinars, workshops, technical demonstrations, or customer training

  • Experience working with product-led growth or self-service SaaS customers

  • Experience using product telemetry or customer activation data to inform customer engagement programs

Who You'll Be Working With

Our team of over 100 attracts talent like executives that wanted to return to building, founders with a 100M+ exit, Roboflow users turned team members, open source contributors, a cyclist who biked across the United States, prolific high school hackers, a CTO from 100+ engineering organization, amongst many exceptional others.

As an early Customer Success Engineer hire, you'll work closely with Support & Success leadership and partner with Product, Sales, and Field Engineering. You won't simply inherit an established playbook — you'll help build the programs, content, tooling, and working practices that define Customer Success at Roboflow.

Where You'll Work

Roboflow is distributed across the US and Europe. We currently have Hubs in New York City, San Francisco and São Paulo (with plans to open more as we grow density in new cities). We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs (we offer a relocation bonus), work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best!

When You'll Work

Roboflow primarily operates during the daytime hours in the US and there are some synchronous meetings you’ll be expected to attend each week.

What You'll Receive

To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every six months to ensure we stay in line with the market.

📈 In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:

  • $4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers

  • $350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space

  • Cover up to 100% of your health insurance costs for you and your partner or family

  • Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision

📅 Within one week, you will…

  • Learn about computer vision, our product, company, customers, and vision

  • Complete the core self-serve Roboflow journey from dataset creation through model training and inference

  • Begin shadowing customer enablement and Support interactions to understand common customer friction

📅 Within one month, you will…

  • Onboard in person with your manager (you'll come to our NY or SF Hub!)

  • Become familiar with the Customer Success Engineer function, Targeted Enablement Option Pack, and its scope boundaries

  • Shadow and begin participating in Targeted Enablement sessions

  • Compose your first Targeted Enablement Program

  • Create or significantly improve your first reusable customer enablement artifact

  • Participate in 1:many enablement webinars

📅 Within six months, you will…

  • Independently own and deliver both recurring 1:many enablement programs and 1:1 Targeted Enablement engagements.

  • Own and improve reusable educational content and enablement programs

  • Identify recurring customer friction and turn those insights into improvements across Product, Support, and CSE

  • Demonstrate measurable contribution to customer adoption and scalable reduction of repetitive enablement demand

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, look into our Former Founders role. We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

Learn More About Us

We are building a diverse Distributed team that is distributed across the globe. Roboflow is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds, communities, and experiences.

We provide competitive compensation and stellar benefits to accelerate your personal and work life. Learn more about what it is like to work at Roboflow by reading these blog posts.

See our careers page for all open listings.

job.title: Senior Manager, Customer Expansion
job.description:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

About the Role

As we scale our post-sale organization, we’re seeking a Senior Manager, Customer Expansion to build and lead our expansion motion across Dandy’s existing customer base.

The team combines proactive BDR-led outbound with high-touch events, training, and field motions that help customers adopt additional products and unlock more value from Dandy.

This role is equal parts strategic builder and people leader. You’ll build the operating model and playbooks, lead through frontline managers across BDR and STS teams, and partner closely with Account Management, Training, Sales, Marketing, and RevOps to make expansion a repeatable, scalable revenue motion.

We’re looking for a strong operator who knows how to build teams, create clarity, coach leaders, and get things done. This isn’t about running an existing sales machine—we’re looking for someone who can build one.

  • Build and lead the Expansion organization, developing a high-performing team through frontline leaders across BDR and STS (Sales & Training Specialist) functions

  • Develop and refine repeatable expansion playbooks across Dandy’s product portfolio, from customer identification and outbound through product education and activation

  • Build the BDR-to-STS motion and the playbook for events, in-person trainings, and other high-touch expansion opportunities

  • Establish the team's operating cadence, metrics, and accountability systems, using leading indicators to identify gaps and drive action

  • Partner with Account Management, Sales, Training, Marketing, Product, and RevOps to identify opportunities and remove friction from the expansion journey

  • Build feedback loops to understand what is working, where customers are getting stuck, and which motions should scale

  • Test, iterate, and operationalize new expansion motions as the business evolves

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of B2B sales, customer growth, or related commercial experience, with 3+ years managing and developing sales teams and frontline leaders

  • Proven track record of building and scaling teams, ideally in a high-growth or evolving environment

  • Strong operational discipline—you naturally bring structure to ambiguous problems, establish clear metrics, and follow through on execution

  • Strong commercial instincts and an understanding of how to translate customer engagement into revenue, adoption, and retention

  • Strong ability to build processes, playbooks, and operating rhythms from scratch

  • High agency and a bias toward action

  • Excellent cross-functional communication and ability to operate effectively across strategy and execution

Bonus Points For

  • Experience building an expansion, cross-sell, account growth, or customer revenue motion

  • Experience managing BDR and/or STS teams through frontline leaders

  • Experience with events, field sales, customer training, or other high-touch commercial motions

  • Experience operating across both SMB and Enterprise

job.title: Support Analyst
job.description:
SUPPORT ANALYST

Fully Remote  |  Full-Time  |  Customer Support  |  Reports to Manager, Support Services |

About the Role

Harris Computer is looking for a driven, tech-savvy Support Analyst to join our growing team. In this role, you'll be the front line of support for our customers — diagnosing technical issues, providing solutions, and ensuring a seamless experience with our software products. You'll report to the Manager, Support Services, and work in a fully remote, fast-paced environment where problem-solving, clear communication, and modern tools, including AI, are part of daily work. If you thrive on solving problems and are passionate about customer success, we want to hear from you.

Why Join Us

  • Work fully remote, with a supportive team and manager invested in your growth
  • Build deep expertise in mission-critical software used by customers who depend on it every day
  • Grow your technical and customer-facing skills, with a clear path to take on more complex, high-impact issues

Core Responsibilities

  • Own assigned customer tickets from intake through resolution, including timely responses, clear status updates, and accurate documentation
  • Diagnose and resolve functional, configuration, data, and software issues by asking effective questions, reproducing problems, and identifying root causes
  • Escalate complex issues to Development, QA, or Product with complete findings, reproduction steps, and actions already attempted
  • Communicate technical information clearly and manage customer expectations throughout the resolution process
  • Learn, implement, and deliver training on our software applications to both customers and internal stakeholders
  • Create and maintain knowledge-base content, including solutions, procedures, and best practices that improve customer self-service
  • Identify recurring issues and product or process gaps, and share trends with the appropriate teams
  • Identify and communicate additional revenue or upsell opportunities to the appropriate internal teams
  • Collaborate with Support colleagues and cross-functional partners, sharing knowledge and contributing to testing when needed

AI Tools & Proficiency

As part of our commitment to innovation, we expect Support Analysts to use AI tools as a core part of their daily workflow, always validating outputs and following company data and privacy requirements.

Required:

  • Demonstrated experience using AI-powered productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Claude) to draft communications, summarize issues, or research solutions
  • Ability to use AI tools to triage, document, and resolve customer support tickets more efficiently
  • Comfort working alongside AI-assisted support platforms, including chatbots and automated ticketing suggestions

Preferred:

  • Basic understanding of prompt engineering — crafting clear, effective prompts to get high-quality outputs from AI tools
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining an AI-assisted knowledge base
  • Familiarity with AI integrations within CRM or helpdesk platforms (e.g., Salesforce Einstein, Zendesk AI)

What we are looking for:

  • 2+ years of experience in technical support, software support, or customer service
  • BS/BA degree in a related business or technical field, or equivalent industry experience
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the discipline to investigate beyond the immediate symptom
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users
  • Customer-focused, professional, and patient approach, with the ability to build trust and remain composed under pressure
  • Strong organization and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a remote environment
  • Team player who is willing to share knowledge, seek help, and support team goals

What would make you stand out:

  • Experience with local government, municipal finance, taxation, or related public-sector workflows
  • Experience with ticketing and work-management platforms such as TeamSupport or Jira
  • Working knowledge of SQL, databases, APIs, or reporting tools
  • Experience creating knowledge-base articles, technical documentation, or customer training content

Salary range: $50,000 - $55,000 USD per year.


AAP/EEO Statement

Harris Computer is an EEO/AA/Disability/Vets Employer.


Other Duties:

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

job.description:

In this dynamic role, you’ll work alongside a collaborative team of clinicians, engineers, physicians, and innovators to execute mapping solutions for cardiac and other electrophysiological systems. If you're driven by precision, problem-solving, and the chance to make a tangible difference in people’s lives, this is your opportunity to grow your career while shaping the future of medical innovation at Medtronic.

We are seeking a committed professional to join our team. While this is a remote position not located at a physical Medtronic site, the candidate hired will be required to reside within the territory and drive to multiple accounts throughout the region. A valid driver's license is essential for this role.


To find all CAS Mapping roles available please use #casmap in the key word search at Medtronic Careers 

Various levels available based on qualifications and experience 

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.

  • Provide clinical and technical support and training to physicians and staff on the EP mapping and navigation system and all CAS products.

  • Develop and cultivate customer relationships resulting in incremental business.

  • Work in partnership with Account Manager, Regional Manager and Area Directors to identify potential sales opportunities.

  • Collaborate and strategize with local sales team to conduct customer training for mapping and other CA Solutions products.

  • Collaborate and communicate with the sales and clinical teams in the region.

  • Serves as an effective Medtronic CAS representative to physicians and support staff regarding Medtronic CAS products, service and support.

  • Serve as a regional champion to share your experience and influence others to be proficient in the mapping technology. 

​

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position. 

We seek out and hire a diverse workforce at every level: We need fresh ideas and inclusive insights to continue to be an innovative industry leader —that’s why we make it a point to seek out, attract and develop employees who are patient-centric, passionate, and who represent the same wide variety of life experiences as our patients.

To learn more about Inclusion & Diversity at Medtronic Click Here

Required Qualifications

To be considered for this role, please ensure these minimum requirements are evident on your resume.

  • High school diploma PLUS a minimum of related 6 years of work experience in cardiac mapping and navigation.
    OR

  • Associate degree PLUS a minimum of related 4 years of work experience in cardiac mapping and navigation.
    OR

  • Bachelor degree plus a minimum of related 2 years of work experience in cardiac mapping and navigation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • B.A./B.S. Degree in nursing, cardiovascular, life sciences, or technical discipline with minimum of four years work experience in cardiac field, hospital/clinic or sales.

  • Proven track record with technical training assignments.

  • Experience in the cardiac catheter ablation field, EP lab, in a hospital/clinic or EP medical sales providing technical / clinical support.

  • Ability to travel more than 25% of the time 



 
Additional Job Requirements

  • Environmental exposure to infectious disease and radiation 

  • Clinical Specialists are required to be within their assigned territory each day to be available as unscheduled needs arise 

  • Clinical Specialists will on occasion be required to travel outside of their assigned territory and possibility overnight 

  • Must have a valid driver’s license 

  • Ability to freely move throughout the facility, use a phone, keyboard and mouse, visually able to interact with personal computers

  • Must be able to stand/sit/walk for 8 hours a day

  • Ability to travel up to 25% 

Must have a valid driver's license and active vehicle insurance policy.  In addition, your driving record will be reviewed and will be considered as part of your application. Must be able to drive approximately 50% of the time within assigned territory and may require overnight travel.

CARDIOVASCULAR PORTFOLIO:

Cardiac Ablation Solutions offers cardiac mapping and ablation solutions to treat patients with abnormal heart rhythms. Our vision is to help patients worldwide by advancing innovation for the diagnosis and ablation of cardiac arrhythmias, enabling clinicians to perform procedures with superior outcomes.

Physical Job Requirements

U.S. Work Authorization & Sponsorship

At Medtronic, we are committed to fostering an environment where employees can thrive and make a meaningful impact. In alignment with our enterprise-wide workforce planning approach, U.S. work authorization sponsorship (H-1B, TN, J, etc.) is offered exclusively for Principal-level roles and above, where specialized expertise aligns with long-term business needs. Roles below the Principal level require candidates to possess unrestricted U.S. work authorization at the time of hire and for the duration of employment.

‌

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com. 

‌

Benefits & Compensation
 

Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package
A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

🚀 About WRITER

WRITER is where the world's leading enterprises orchestrate AI-powered work. Our vision is to expand human capacity through superintelligence. And we're proving it's possible – through powerful, trustworthy AI that unites IT and business teams together to unlock enterprise-wide transformation. With WRITER's end-to-end platform, hundreds of companies like Mars, Marriott, Uber, and Vanguard are building and deploying AI agents that are grounded in their company's data and fueled by WRITER's enterprise-grade LLMs. Valued at $1.9B and backed by industry-leading investors including Premji Invest, Radical Ventures, and ICONIQ Growth, WRITER is rapidly cementing its position as the leader in enterprise generative AI.

Founded in 2020 with office hubs in San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, Austin, Chicago, and London, our team thinks big and moves fast, and we're looking for smart, hardworking builders and scalers to join us on our journey to create a better future of work with AI.

📐 About the role

Writer is the enterprise AI platform for agentic work, purpose-built for the Fortune 500 — and our platform is expanding fast. As a product marketing lead, you'll own the go-to-market strategy for new products and features in our Core app, helping prospects understand how WRITER empowers marketing and sales teams to transform their work, and driving new feature adoption among current customers. You'll sit at the intersection of product, sales, and marketing — translating complex platform capabilities into crisp messaging that resonates with enterprise buyers.

🦸🏻‍♀️ What you’ll do

  • Own end-to-end product marketing for WRITER Agent and other key features of our core app, including positioning, messaging, launch strategy, and competitive differentiation – translating new agentic capabilities into clear enterprise value

  • Translate product investments into sales-ready narratives, partner with sales enablement to educate the field, and develop assets — pitch materials, one-pagers, objection-handling guides — that equip the field to sell our latest innovations

  • Drive product and feature adoption through regular user communications and programs

  • Conduct ongoing competitive intelligence and market research to sharpen differentiation against both point solutions and broader AI platforms

  • Collaborate with cross-functional marketing partners to ensure consistent product messaging across the buyer journey

⭐️ What you need

  • 6+ years of product marketing experience, or 3+ years of product marketing experience paired with 5+ years in a related field (e.g. sales enablement, customer success, customer education, or product management), in a B2B SaaS environment

  • AI native mindset with proven experience using agentic AI to automate GTM workflows

  • Proven track record of bringing complex products to market with clear, compelling positioning for both technical and business audiences

  • Strong sales enablement instincts — you know how to build narratives and assets that actually get used in the field

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, and Customer Success in a fast-moving environment

  • Excellent written communication

  • Experience or familiarity with the enterprise AI or agentic AI landscape is a strong plus

job.title: Lead Instructional Designer
job.description:
About Neon One

At Neon One, we believe that technology is the key to building vibrant communities of generosity. As a leader in nonprofit software since 2004, we create intuitive solutions that help small and mid-sized nonprofits connect with people, build trust, and make good happen every day.

Our culture is powered by empathy, innovation, and a shared mission to empower organizations making a difference. We operate with a customer-first mindset, take pride in extraordinary results, and grow together by supporting each other and embracing bold new ideas. If you’re passionate about using your skills to drive real impact and want to thrive in a collaborative, fully remote environment, Neon One is the place for you.

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic, highly collaborative, and technically proficient Lead Instructional Designer to drive our instructional design strategy. In this pivotal individual contributor role, you will be a technical visionary and the primary engine for moving complex learning initiatives forward. You will partner closely with the Technical Writing function to ensure seamless alignment between our product documentation and learning pathways. Additionally, you will serve as the primary stakeholder in our transition to a newly built, custom Learning Management System (LMS). By partnering directly with external developers, product managers, and subject matter experts, you will define the instructional UX, authoring requirements, and system capabilities needed to deliver a world-class customer education experience.

Responsibilities

  • Cross-Functional Project Leadership: Act as the central driver for learning initiatives. Build strong partnerships across departments, proactively manage stakeholder expectations, and keep complex projects moving forward on schedule without relying on direct reporting lines.

  • LMS Migration & Strategic Ownership: Act as the primary business owner for offboarding our current academy (Skilljar) and transitioning to a custom-built LMS. Define system requirements (e.g., authoring workflows, learner UX) and guide external developers to ensure the platform meets both customer needs and instructional design standards.

  • Team Collaboration & Workflow Design: Work closely with the Technical Writer, Enablement Manager, and Customer Operations Managers to establish scalable design systems, style guides, and AI-assisted content workflows that make our learning content accessible to our customer base.

  • Technical Curriculum & Certification: Architect end-to-end learning pathways, role-based certifications, and self-paced academies for admin users and enterprise clients.

  • Hands-On Lab & Interactive Design: Design scenario-based, interactive learning experiences, including simulated environments, sandbox exercises, and API/code walkthrough tutorials.

  • Product Alignment & Release Management: Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and Solutions Architects to translate complex feature updates and technical specs into timely, accurate learning content.

  • Telemetry & Business Impact: Track learner telemetry (e.g., product adoption rates, time-to-value, course completion, certification pass rates) to continuously measure and prove ROI on customer and internal enablement.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience: 5+ years in instructional design within a B2B SaaS, developer tooling, or high-growth tech environment. Proven project management experience with a track record of driving cross-functional initiatives as a highly autonomous individual contributor.

  • Custom LMS / Systems Expertise: Hands-on experience defining requirements for LMS implementations, migrations, or custom builds. Deep understanding of what an instructional designer needs from a platform to successfully host and track courses (SCORM, xAPI, LTI).

  • Technical Aptitude: Comfort navigating API documentation, cloud architectures, developer workflows, or SaaS platform configurations to build technical curriculum independently.

  • Tooling & Tech Stack:

    • Advanced proficiency in modern authoring & media tools (Articulate 360, Camtasia, Loom, Figma).

    • Strong familiarity with transitioning out of standard Customer Education / LXP platforms (e.g., Skilljar) into custom environments.

  • Core Competencies: Agile development methodologies, rapid prototyping (SAM), data-driven decision-making, and exceptional cross-functional stakeholder management. Must possess the consultative skills necessary to influence peers, align differing viewpoints, and maintain project momentum.

Why Join Neon One?

At Neon One, our values are how we show up every day. We make good happen by putting empathy and passion at the center of our work, using technology to uplift mission-driven organizations. We stand for our customers, act with care and intention in every decision, own the solution, and grow together. We innovate fearlessly, always exploring new ways to support our community and each other.

How We Hire

job.title: Business Development Consultant, Cranial And Spinal Technologies - Remote
job.description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 25 Sep 2026


 

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

As one of Medtronic’s three comprehensive portfolios, Neuroscience is dedicated to improving the lives of people living with neurological disorders, spine conditions, and chronic pain. Guided by our Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life, our Cranial & Spinal Technologies (CST) Operating Unit develops and delivers an integrated ecosystem of spinal implants, navigation and robotic guidance systems, advanced imaging, and data-driven planning tools for complex spine and cranial procedures. Platforms such as AiBLE connect these technologies to enhance surgical precision, streamline workflows, and support improved patient outcomes around the world.

The Business Development Consultant is responsible for identifying, developing, and advancing growth opportunities across the Cranial & Spinal Technologies portfolio. This role builds strong relationships with healthcare customers and stakeholders, evaluates market opportunities, and partners cross-functionally to drive strategic growth, customer value, and business performance.

Primary Responsibilities:


  • Develop and execute business development and market development plans aligned with organizational priorities
  • Identify, qualify, and pursue new business opportunities across assigned markets and accounts
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with surgeons, hospital leaders, health systems, distributors, and other key stakeholders
  • Assess customer needs and recommend solutions that maximize the value of Medtronic’s products and services
  • Conduct market, customer, and competitive analysis to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities
  • Develop account and opportunity strategies, including stakeholder mapping, value propositions, and action plans
  • Partner with sales, marketing, clinical, medical education, finance, contracting, and other cross-functional teams to advance opportunities
  • Communicate customer insights, competitive intelligence, and product feedback to internal stakeholders, including Marketing, Operations, and Research & Development
  • Support product launches, customer education, demonstrations, workshops, and strategic business initiatives
  • Track opportunity pipelines, activity, and outcomes; provide regular updates and recommendations to leadership
  • Promote compliance with Medtronic policies, quality systems, applicable regulations, and ethical business practices
  • Travel as needed to support customers, field teams, meetings, and business priorities

Required Qualifications:


  • High school diploma or equivalent and 12+ years of relevant sales, clinical, or related experience; or Associate’s degree and 10+ years of relevant experience; or Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of relevant experience
  • Relevant experience in medical devices, medtech, healthcare, life sciences, business development, or complex solution selling
  • Demonstrated ability to develop relationships, identify opportunities, and influence decisions across complex customer environments
  • Strong business acumen, strategic thinking, negotiation, presentation, and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a matrixed organization
  • Willingness and ability to travel as required
  • Valid driver’s license and active vehicle insurance policy

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Experience with spine, cranial, biologics, enabling technologies, robotics, navigation, imaging, or related surgical technologies
  • Experience working with hospitals, integrated delivery networks, health systems, or large strategic accounts
  • Established relationships with healthcare professionals and executive-level customers
  • Experience developing market strategies, business cases, or customer value propositions
  • Strong analytical skills and experience using data to guide business decisions 

For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position. 

The physical demands described within the Responsibilities section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. For Office Roles: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers. Contact your manager or local HR to understand the Work Conditions and Physical requirements that may be specific to each role.

U.S. Work Authorization & Sponsorship

At Medtronic, we are committed to fostering an environment where employees can thrive and make a meaningful impact. In alignment with our enterprise-wide workforce planning approach, U.S. work authorization sponsorship (H-1B, TN, J, etc.) is offered exclusively for Principal-level roles and above, where specialized expertise aligns with long-term business needs. Roles below the Principal level require candidates to possess unrestricted U.S. work authorization at the time of hire and for the duration of employment.

‌

Recruitment Fraud Alert

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind: 


Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses. 


Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate. 


If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments. 


If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com. 

‌

Benefits & Compensation
 

Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package
A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.
 

Salary ranges for U.S (excl. PR) locations (USD):175000-175000
The base salary range is applicable across the United States, excluding Puerto Rico and specific locations in California. The offered rate complies with federal and local regulations and may vary based on factors such as experience, certification/education, market conditions, and location. Compensation and benefits information pertains solely to candidates hired within the United States (local market compensation and benefits will apply for others).

In addition to Base Salary, this position is eligible for a Sales Incentive Plan (SIP), which provides the opportunity to earn significant incentive compensation for achieving or exceeding your goals.

The following benefits and additional compensation are available to those regular employees who work 20+ hours per week: Health, Dental and vision insurance,Health Savings Account,Healthcare Flexible Spending Account,Life insurance, Long-term disability leave,Dependent daycare spending account,Tuition assistance/reimbursement, andSimple Steps (global well-being program).

The following benefits and additional compensation are available to all regular employees:Incentive plans, 401(k) plan plus employer contribution and match,Short-term disability,Paid time off,Paid holidays,Employee Stock Purchase Plan,Employee Assistance Program,Non-qualified Retirement Plan Supplement (subject to IRS earning minimums), andCapital Accumulation Plan (available to Vice Presidents and above, or subject to IRS earning minimums).

Regular employees are those who are not temporary, such as interns.  Temporary employees are eligible for paid sick time, as required under applicable state law, and the Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Please note some of the above benefits may not apply to workers in Puerto Rico.

Community team</li> <li>Partnering with cross-functional team partners to understand shared processes and audiences&nbsp;</li> <li>Launching your first customer-facing program</li> </ul> <p>Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:</p> <ul> <li>Driving and delivering 2027 priorities and roadmap, as well as yearly team performance reviews</li> <li>Using your deep understanding of our customers’ success stories to identify strategic areas of opportunity to improve community and advocacy programs and processes</li> <li>Actively tracking engagement and business impact metrics&nbsp;</li> <li>Serve as the point person across Sprout for Customer Advocacy &amp; job.title: Senior Manager, Brand Marketing
job.description:
About CertifyOS

CertifyOS is building the data infrastructure that powers modern healthcare.

Today, healthcare organizations rely on fragmented and outdated provider data. This creates unnecessary administrative work, regulatory risk, and higher costs across the system. We’re solving that problem.

Our API-first platform automates provider licensing, enrollment, credentialing, and network monitoring by connecting directly to hundreds of primary data sources. We help healthcare organizations maintain accurate, compliant, and reliable provider networks at scale.

Our vision is simple:One API. One provider ID. Frictionless provider data.

We’re backed by leading investors and built by a team with deep experience in provider data systems. At CertifyOS, we value authenticity, accountability, collaboration, results, and openness to feedback. We’re building a high-ownership team focused on solving real infrastructure problems that impact millions of patients.

About the role:

We are seeking a Senior Manager of Brand Marketing to own Certify's brand presence, content output, and audience-building channels end-to-end. This is a high-impact, creative-meets- strategic role for someone who can simultaneously build a cohesive brand identity and operatethe full content engine that brings it to life — from thought leadership to LinkedIn, events,podcasts, employer brand, and corporate communications.

You will help define how Certify shows up in the market — shaping perception among healthplan buyers, potential hires, and industry stakeholders. This role requires equal parts brandvision and content discipline. You will own the editorial calendar, manage all owned channels,and ensure every piece of content is consistent, compelling, and connected to businessobjectives.

What you'll do:

1. Brand Development & Identity

  • Steward Certify's brand identity — including voice, tone, visual language, and positioning ensuring consistency across all internal and external touchpoints.

  • Maintain and help evolve the living brand guidelines system — covering written style, design standards, messaging hierarchies, and channel-specific adaptations.

  • Lead periodic brand audits to evaluate consistency, resonance, and market perception, using findings to evolve the brand as Certify grows.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and leadership to ensure brand positioning is tightly integrated with Certify's market strategy and competitive narrative.

2. Content Strategy & Production

  • Own the master content strategy and editorial calendar, ensuring all content reinforces CertifyOS’ brand narrative, category POV, campaign priorities, and audience insights across channels.

  • Develop distinctive thought leadership that translates market trends, customer pain points, regulatory pressure, and product strategy into compelling content for health plan executives and provider operations leaders.

  • Lead the creation of high-quality content across articles, blogs, LinkedIn, newsletters, video scripts, webinars, event presentations, white papers, contributed industry pieces, and sales enablement assets.

  • Build a repeatable content production engine using AI tools, internal SMEs, customer insights, and external partners to scale output without sacrificing quality, originality, or editorial rigor.

  • Partner with Marketing, BD, Product, Customer Success, and the executive team to ensure content directly supports pipeline creation, customer education, product launches, events, and market authority.

3. Owned Channels: Podcast, LinkedIn & Newsletter

  • Own and operate Certify's podcast — from guest strategy and topic selection to production workflow, episode publishing, and audience growth.

  • Drive Certify's LinkedIn presence as a brand-building channel — developing a content cadence, growing follower engagement, and managing both company page and executive ghostwriting programs.

  • Build and grow Certify's owned newsletter — developing the editorial voice, subscriber growth strategy, and content rhythm that turns subscribers into advocates.

  • Track channel-level performance metrics and use data to continuously optimize content type, frequency, and distribution strategy.

4. Events & Sponsorships

  • Own Certify's events strategy — identifying, evaluating, and executing on industry conferences, roundtables, webinars, and proprietary events that build brand visibility and pipeline.

  • Manage event logistics end-to-end: booth presence, speaker submissions, session content, on-site materials, and post-event follow-up campaigns.

5. Employer Brand & Internal Communications

  • Develop and execute Certify's employer brand strategy — defining what it means to work at Certify and translating that into recruiting content, Glassdoor presence, careers page, and social storytelling.

  • Partner with People & Talent to build a talent marketing program that attracts mission- driven candidates who align with Certify's culture and values.

  • Own corporate communications — drafting executive announcements, company updates, investor communications, and press releases in Certify's voice.

  • Build internal brand engagement programs that reinforce culture and ensure employees are proud ambassadors of the Certify brand externally.

What Success Looks Like

  • Brand Consistency: A documented brand guidelines system live within 60 days; 100% of external content passing brand review within 90 days.

  • Content Velocity: Weekly content output across LinkedIn, blog, and newsletter sustained at scale; editorial calendar planned 4+ weeks ahead.

  • Podcast Growth: Podcast launched within 90 days; 10+ episodes published within 6 months with measurable audience growth quarter over quarter.

  • Channel Performance: LinkedIn follower growth ≥20% quarter over quarter; newsletter open rates above industry benchmark; event ROI tracked and reported.

What you'll need:

Must-Have Experience

  • 6–10+ years in brand marketing, content strategy, or editorial leadership — with a track record of building or transforming a brand at a healthcare or technology company.

  • Demonstrated experience owning content operations at scale — building editorial systems, managing production workflows, and maintaining quality across high-volume output.

job.title: Senior Sales Enablement Manager, Smb & Mid-market
job.description:
What we’re building and why we’re building it. 

Fetch helps people live rewarded every day, with a vision to become the rewards destination for everyone. We turn everyday activities into meaningful rewards, whether it’s grocery shopping, grabbing a quick meal, or playing a favorite mobile game. To date, we’ve awarded more than $1 billion in Fetch Points to our users.

Each day, more than 13 million receipts are submitted on Fetch, providing visibility into over $212 billion in gross merchandise value. This creates the largest retail-agnostic, SKU-level view of household spending, powering Fetch as an outcomes-based advertising platform that helps brands acquire and retain lifelong consumers.

The Fetch app is available on the App Store and Google Play, with more than 6 million five-star reviews from a highly engaged and loyal user base.

It’s not just our users who believe in Fetch: with investments from Softbank, ICONIQ, DST, Greycroft, and partnerships ranging from challenger brands to Fortune 500 companies, Fetch is reshaping how brands and consumers connect in the marketplace. When you work at Fetch, you play a vital role in a platform that drives brand loyalty and creates lifelong consumers with the power of Fetch points. User and partner success are at the heart of everything we do, and we extend that same commitment to our employees.

At Fetch, we value curiosity, adaptability, and the confidence to explore new tools, especially AI, to drive smarter, faster work. You don’t need to be an expert, but you should be ready to learn quickly and think critically. We welcome learners who move fast, challenge the status quo, and shape what’s next, with us.  Ranked as one of America’s Best Startup Employers by Forbes for two years in a row, Fetch fosters a people-first culture rooted in trust, accountability, and innovation. We encourage our employees to challenge ideas, think bigger, and always bring the fun to Fetch.
About the Role:

Fetch is investing in dedicated enablement support for two important growth segments: Mid-Market, an established and rapidly expanding business, and SMB, a new business that is being built from the ground up.

We are seeking a Sales Enablement Manager to serve as the embedded enablement partner for both teams. This role will simplify how sellers understand and sell Fetch's packages, build and maintain segment-specific onboarding and playbooks, and create a repeatable go-to-market motion that helps new and existing sellers become productive faster.
This is a builder role for someone who can move between strategy and execution diagnosing what is getting in the way of performance, translating complex offerings into practical sales guidance, and partnering closely with leaders and managers to reinforce the right behaviors in the flow of work.

Reporting to the Director of Sales Enablement, this role will partner closely with the Director to translate the overall Sales Enablement strategy into an SMB and Mid-Market-specific roadmap. They will also work closely with a Sales Enablement Manager peer who leads broader programs and supports Fetch’s other verticals. Together, the team will preserve a consistent company-wide approach while ensuring MM and SMB needs are considered early and reflected wherever the sales motion requires a different approach.

This is a full-time role that can be held from one of our US offices or remotely in the United States.

Responsibilities:

Segment Enablement Strategy & GTM Motion

  •  Serve as the primary enablement partner to SMB and Mid-Market Sales leaders, aligning priorities and enablement roadmaps to each segment's goals, seller needs, and stage of maturity.
  • Build and operationalize a clear, repeatable SMB sales motion while continuously evolving the Mid-Market motion as the team and opportunity set grow.
  • Translate business priorities into the processes, skills, messaging, tools, and reinforcement sellers need to execute consistently.
  • Use seller feedback, call insights, pipeline data, and performance trends to identify the highest-impact skill, process, and content gaps.

Onboarding, Ramp & Readiness

  • Take ownership of the customized Mid-Market onboarding already in development and continuously improve the end-to-end ramp experience for MM and future SMB sellers.
  • Build and maintain distinct learning paths for Mid-Market Growth, Mid-Market New Business, and future SMB roles, incorporating segment- and role-specific training, practice, certifications, and manager-led reinforcement.
  • Adapt shared onboarding content where the MM/SMB motion differs—for example, cold outreach and discovery for new business, segment-specific package details, and more accessible entry points.
  • Partner with frontline managers to define readiness expectations and ensure a consistent handoff from formal onboarding into in-role coaching.
  • Track time-to-readiness and time-to-productivity, using results to improve the ramp experience and remove friction for new hires.

Sales Packages, Playbooks & Training

  • Partner with GTM, Product Marketing, Sales, and Revenue Operations to simplify Fetch's products and packages into clear, sellable solutions for SMB and Mid-Market customers.
  • Own the creation and ongoing maintenance of every required MM/SMB version of broader training, package guidance, pitch decks, playbooks, talk tracks, and seller tools.
  • Translate shared offerings into the right MM/SMB execution—including package variances and more accessible entry levels, cold-outreach and new-business discovery motions, segment-relevant positioning, and role-specific pitch guidance.
  • Build practical segment playbooks that include buyer needs, outreach and discovery guidance, positioning, talk tracks, package selection, objection handling, proof points, measurement guidance, and execution steps.
  • Develop and facilitate targeted live and on-demand training for ramped and unramped sellers, grounded in real opportunities and the skills most likely to improve performance.
  • Convert launches and one-time trainings into reusable learning, coaching tools, and reinforcement that drive sustained adoption and behavior change.
  • Maintain accurate, easy-to-use segment content in Letter AI in partnership with the broader enablement content owner and established governance standards.

Enablement Peer & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Work closely with the Sales Enablement Manager serving other verticals to co-plan the roadmap, preserve consistent core messaging and methods, and identify MM/SMB versioning needs before broader programs are finalized.
  • Operate from shared standards and sources of truth rather than building a parallel enablement system; clearly divide ownership of core assets and MM/SMB adaptations.
  • Equip frontline managers with coaching guides, call-review frameworks, readiness checkpoints, and team exercises that reinforce the segment motion.
  • Develop deep working relationships with GTM partners responsible for product launches, media units, and Moments, representing MM/SMB requirements while plans, packages, and activation details are still being shaped.
  • Influence cross-functional plans so new products and activations have a compelling, executable fit for MM/SMB customers rather than requiring late-stage retrofitting.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, AIM, and other subject-matter experts to turn complex inputs into clear seller actions.
  • Create a reliable feedback loop between the field and cross-functional partners so messaging, packages, processes, and training improve as the businesses evolve.
  • Represent SMB and Mid-Market enablement needs in broader Sales Enablement planning while reusing shared programs and standards wherever they create scale.

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

  • Define and track success measures for onboarding, training, package adoption, and seller proficiency, including leading and lagging indicators.
  • Track MM and SMB participation and completion across required trainings, following up with sellers and managers to close gaps and maintain clear visibility into readiness.
  • Monitor Gong adoption and use call reviews, manager observation, assessments, content usage, seller feedback, and commercial performance data to determine whether training is being applied in the field.
  • Use observed field behaviors to target reinforcement, coaching, content updates, and future training rather than treating completion as the finish line.
  • Use Letter AI, Gong, Salesforce, and AI-enabled workflows to improve learning, surface performance insights, and make enablement easier to access in the flow of work.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Sales Enablement, Revenue Enablement, Sales Training, or a comparable commercial role; experience supporting SMB and/or Mid-Market sales teams is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success building or improving onboarding, playbooks, training, coaching, or sales motions that produced measurable changes in seller performance.
  • Strong understanding of high-velocity SMB selling and consultative Mid-Market selling, with the judgment to tailor enablement to different cycle lengths, buyers, and levels of deal complexity.
  • Ability to simplify complex products, pricing, packaging, and processes into clear guidance sellers can confidently use with customers.
  • Experience using data and qualitative insights to diagnose performance gaps, prioritize programs, and measure impact.
  • Strong facilitation, coaching, program management, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to operate independently and build structure in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Experience with LMS/CMS platforms, CRM, conversation intelligence, and AI-enabled sales or learning tools.
  • Prior quota-carrying sales experience or meaningful experience coaching sellers in-role is strongly preferred.

What Success Looks Like

  • A clear, repeatable SMB sales motion is documented, taught, reinforced, and improved as the new team scales.
  • Customized onboarding and ramp paths for Mid-Market Growth, Mid-Market New Business, and future SMB roles remain current and help sellers reach meaningful readiness milestones faster.
  • Every broader enablement initiative that requires MM/SMB nuance has a clear, current segment version without creating conflicting narratives or disconnected systems.
  • Fetch's packages are easier for MM/SMB sellers to understand, select, position, and execute, with appropriate entry points and guidance for their buyers and sales motions.
  • MM/SMB requirements influence product launches, media units, and Moments early enough that the resulting plans are compelling and executable for the segments.
  • Training completion and Gong-based field application are visible, with managers receiving timely follow-up and reinforcement support.
  • Segment playbooks and training are trusted, current, and consistently used in live selling situations.
  • Enablement priorities are driven by measurable performance needs, with visible improvement in proficiency, adoption, conversion, deal velocity, or other agreed commercial outcomes.
Compensation:
At Fetch, we offer competitive compensation packages including base, equity, and benefits to the exceptional folks we hire. The base salary range for this position is $141,131-$166,036. Discover our benefits and how our employees live rewarded at https://fetch.com/careers.
At Fetch, we'll give you the tools to feel healthy, happy and secure through:

  • Equity: We offer full-time employees equity in Fetch, so that everyone can benefit from Fetch’s growth.
  • 401k Match: Dollar-for-dollar match up to 4%.
  • Benefits for humans and pets: We offer comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans for everyone including your pets.
  • Continuing Education: Fetch provides ten thousand per year in education reimbursement.
  • Employee Resource Groups: Take part in employee-led groups that are centered around fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace through events, dialogue and advocacy. The ERGs participate in our Inclusion Council with members of executive leadership.
  • Paid Time Off: On top of our flexible PTO, Fetch observes 9 paid holidays, as well as our year-end week-long break. 
  • Robust Leave Policies: 20 weeks of paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 14 weeks for secondary caregivers, and a flexible return to work schedule. 
  • Calvin Care Cash: Employees who are welcoming new family members will also receive a one time $2,000 incentive to assist employees with covering the cost of childcare, clothing, diapers and much more!
  • Flexible Work Environment: Collaborate with your team in one of our stunning offices, or you can work fully remotely from anywhere in the US. We’ll ensure you are equally equipped with the hardware and software you need to get your job done in the comfort of your home. (applicable for most roles)

Fetch is an equal opportunity employer that embraces diversity, inclusion, and respect for all individuals. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Our commitment to inclusivity ensures that everyone is treated with dignity and has the opportunity to succeed based on their talent, skills, and potential.

Fetch also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities or those with sincerely held religious beliefs, as required by law. If you need assistance with the application process or require an accommodation, please contact us at accommodations@fetch.com.

job.title: Customer Education Specialist
job.description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

*Open to hiring remote across the US — we also have offices in NYC, San Francisco, and Seattle

Runway is growing fast, and so is the surface area of what users need to learn. We're looking for an Education Content Specialist to keep our Help Center accurate, our Academy content well-produced, and our users set up for success from day one.

You'll sit within the Experience & Enterprise Enablement team, working closely with the Education & Enablement lead to execute against a content roadmap that spans written documentation, video scripts, and self-service resources. Every feature launch will have your fingerprints on it. You're the person who makes sure users don't have to guess.

What you’ll do

  • Write, update, and maintain Help Center articles across product features, billing, policies, and troubleshooting — keeping documentation accurate as the product moves fast

  • Coordinate with engineering and product at launch time to ensure articles are live before features ship

  • Audit existing Help Center content for accuracy and discoverability; surface recommendations based on support ticket trends and user feedback

  • Create and maintain self-service content — FAQs, quick-start guides, troubleshooting flows — that reduces ticket volume and helps users help themselves

  • Draft scripts for Runway Academy video tutorials, walkthroughs, and course modules

  • Support production of Academy content: create supporting assets, prepare materials for recording, and help get finished content published and organized

  • Build and maintain a library of templates, prompt guides, and project starters across Runway's tools

  • Support production and publishing of office hours, webinars, and live Q&A sessions

  • Keep Help Center documentation and Academy content consistent and cross-referenced

  • Track the performance of content you've produced — article engagement, search deflection, CSAT — and flag gaps to the Education & Enablement lead

  • Work with legal to ensure usage policies and terms are accurately reflected in customer-facing content

What you’ll need

  • 2-3 years of experience in technical writing, documentation, education content, or a similar role at a software or SaaS company

  • Ability to translate complex product features into clear, user-friendly language — across articles, scripts, and guides

  • Experience shipping documentation on tight timelines with cross-functional dependencies

  • Comfort with help center platforms (Zendesk, Intercom, or similar) and content management systems

  • Familiarity with video content production and an instinct for how to structure and pace educational content

  • Strong editorial judgment — you catch inconsistencies before they go live

  • Organized and autonomous working style; you can manage a documentation backlog while staying responsive to urgent launch needs

  • A bias toward action and a belief that no task is too small

  • Familiarity building with LLMs to streamline and automate processes

Nice to have

  • Experience with AI or creative tools — with genuine curiosity about how they work

  • Background in or passion for the creative space — video, design, animation, or related fields

  • Experience using support data (ticket volume, search queries, CSAT, completion rates) to prioritize content work

Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.

Working at Runway

job.title: Client Support Representative - Healthcare Revenue Cycle
job.description:
Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

Job Description

As our Healthcare Revenue Cycle, Tier 2 Client Support Representative, you will manage and resolve complex issues escalated from our teams and external clients.

You will partner with clients, payers, trading partners, and internal technical teams to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve issues, while delivering a high level of customer support.

You will be a problem solver who can balance technical troubleshooting, client communication, and collaboration in a healthcare technology environment.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex product, system, and workflow-related issues.
  • Investigate and resolve payer-related and transaction-processing issues.
  • Be an escalation point for Customer Support, Client Relationship Management, and other teams.
  • Manage a high-volume caseload of support requests, incidents, and inquiries while meeting established service level expectations.
  • Communicate with clients through support cases, email, telephone, and virtual meetings to guide issue resolution and maintain client relationships.
  • Determine the severity, scope, and effect of reported issues and coordinate appropriate resolution efforts.
  • Collaborate with internal technical teams, payers, vendors, and trading partners to investigate and resolve client-affecting issues.
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and maintain client and user configurations.
  • Participate in small to medium-sized projects, including testing, implementations, process improvements, and operational plans.
  • Create, maintain, and enhance internal and external knowledge base documentation using Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) best practices.
  • Identify recurring issues, trends, and process improvement opportunities and provide recommendations to improve our client experience.
  • Maintain a comprehensive understanding of supported products, workflows, and industry standards.

Qualifications

  • 2+ year's experience with healthcare workflows, payer processes, and electronic healthcare transactions is beneficial
  • 2+ years' experience with healthcare industry standards such as ANSI X12 transactions is beneficial
  • 2+ years' experience using CRM or case management systems, such as Salesforce, is beneficial
  • Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare management, or a related field is beneficial
  • 2+ years; experience in healthcare technology, healthcare operations, revenue cycle management, technical support, or a related field
  • Experience supporting client-facing software applications
  • Experience working with healthcare providers, payers, clearinghouses, or healthcare technology solutions

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. job.title: Support Engineer III
job.description:
Blackpoint Cyber is the leading provider of world-class cybersecurity threat hunting, detection and remediation technology. Founded by former National Security Agency (NSA) cyber operations experts who applied their learnings to bring national security-grade technology solutions to commercial customers around the world, Blackpoint Cyber is in hyper-growth mode,  fueled by a recent $190m series C round. 

The Role:

We are looking for a Support Engineer III with experience in software technical support, particularly in environments utilizing Zendesk automation and complex software workflows. This is a hybrid role: you'll provide expert-level technical assistance to our customers while also building and optimizing the automation and processes that power our support operations.

You will be responsible for handling complex issues escalated from Tier 1 and Tier 2 teams, requiring a deep understanding of our software, underlying microservices, and support tools. If you're passionate about delivering exceptional customer service, solving intricate technical problems, and are skilled in support automation, we want you on our team.


Responsibilities and Expectations:

Technical Support

  • Serve as an expert resource for complex technical issues, resolving escalated support cases with precision and efficiency.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve software issues, focusing on microservices, APIs, and system integrations.

  • Leverage your expertise in software workflows to diagnose and resolve system anomalies, deployment challenges, and configuration issues.

  • Collaborate with the Engineering and Product teams to identify, report, and prioritize software bugs and enhancements.

  • Analyze ticket trends and use data to implement proactive solutions, reducing ticket volume and improving response times.

  • Create and maintain detailed documentation, knowledge base articles, and support resources.

  • Mentor and train junior engineers, enhancing overall team competency and knowledge sharing.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize the customer support journey.

Support Operations & Automation

  • Utilize Zendesk automation and other support tools to streamline workflows, optimize ticket management, and enhance customer satisfaction.

  • Develop, implement, and optimize automated solutions to enhance technical support operations, using tools like Superblocks, n8n, Tines, and webhooks.

  • Perform account management request analysis and automate routine and manual tasks.

  • Collaborate closely with the Support team to understand operational needs and develop automation strategies that improve operational efficiency.

  • Document automation processes and provide comprehensive training materials to enable the Support team to effectively use new tools and procedures.

Key Skills and Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in a Technical Support or Customer Support role, with a focus on complex software environments.

  • Proficiency in Zendesk, especially in utilizing automations, triggers, and macros to optimize support workflows.

  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture, including APIs, containers (Docker), and cloud services.

  • Strong troubleshooting methodology across the following areas:

  • Advanced knowledge of Windows, macOS, and Linux operating systems.

  • Experience with PowerShell, Sysinternals Suite, and remote support tools.

  • Familiarity with scripting languages (Python, Bash, or Ansible — one or more preferred).

  • Strong grasp of networking concepts (IP addressing, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, firewalls, etc.).

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and understanding of DevOps practices.

  • Demonstrated ability to understand and optimize support workflows to improve efficiency and customer satisfaction.

  • Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or Security+ are a plus, but not required.

Desired Soft Skills

  • Exceptional problem-solving skills with a knack for diagnosing complex issues quickly.

  • Strong customer communication skills, able to explain technical concepts to non-technical users effectively.

  • Highly self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to multi-task and manage multiple priorities with excellent time management skills.

  • Passionate about continuous learning and professional development.

Blackpoint Cyber welcomes and encourages applications from qualified individuals of all races, colors, religions, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, marital status, or any other legally protected status. We are committed to equality of opportunity in all aspects of employment.

For eligible employees in the US, Blackpoint offers competitive Health, Vision, Dental, and Life Insurance plans, a robust 401k plan, Discretionary Time Off, and other minor perks. International employees receive competitive benefits in accordance with local market standards and applicable country requirements.
