job.title: Vice President of Commercial Operations
job.description:
Vice President of Commercial Operations

BusPatrol is seeking a high skilled Vice President of Commercial Operations. The VP, Commercial Operations will lead BusPatrol’s Sales Enablement and RFP functions, building the operating discipline, tools, content, training, and cross-functional coordination required to scale a complex B2G commercial motion. This leader will improve seller readiness and execution and professionalizing BusPatrol's RFP engine through clear standard work, stronger workflows, quality controls, and responsible AI adoption. The role will connect Sales, RevOps, Marketing, Policy/Government Relations, Legal, Product, and Post-Sales around a consistent, measurable go-to-market system.

Responsibilities:

  1. Own the Sales Enablement strategy and operating model. Establish the function’s mandate, roadmap, governance, intake and prioritization process, decision rights, service levels, and annual/quarterly operating cadence in alignment with the company’s commercial strategy.

  1. Build the training and development architecture. Lead onboarding, continuous training, manager coaching, launch support, certification, and field reinforcement programs that improve execution in BusPatrol’s complex, multi-stakeholder B2G sales environment.

  1. Drive sales methodology adoption and field performance. Embed consistent sales processes, stage expectations, management routines, and practical reinforcement mechanisms that improve execution, deal progression, and seller effectiveness.

  1. Create and govern the commercial content and tools system. Ensure that playbooks, stage guidance, talk tracks, battlecards, account-planning tools, stakeholder maps, state/policy guidance, CRM resources, and other field assets are practical, current, reusable, and accessible through a governed source of truth.

  1. Orchestrate cross-functional GTM alignment and field feedback. Connect Sales, RevOps, Marketing, Policy/Government Relations, Legal, RFP, Product, and Post-Sales so that commercial insights, process changes, market developments, and frontline feedback are translated into coordinated enablement priorities and field support.

  1. Establish and operate a commercial deal desk. Shepherd the last mile of contract execution by coordinating Sales, Legal, Finance, implementation, and installation; resolving deal-execution issues; ensuring commercial and operational readiness; and creating a smooth handoff from closed-won opportunity through delivery

  1. Lead and professionalize the RFP team. Improve the quality, consistency, speed, and predictability of RFP responses through standard work, clear workflows, reusable content, response templates, content governance, effective SME coordination, quality controls, and disciplined submission management—while maintaining the team’s core mandate and operating model.

  1. Build competitive intelligence capability. Establish repeatable processes for competitive snapshots, account briefs, stakeholder maps, opportunity watchlists, and field-ready competitive guidance that help teams understand market dynamics, competitive posture, and account context.

  1. Measure impact and drive continuous improvement. Define and manage performance measures across enablement and RFP operations, including adoption, ramp, manager usage, process adherence, stage conversion, pipeline quality, win-rate contribution, forecast confidence, RFP cycle time, response quality, reuse, and productivity.

Qualifications:

  • 12+ years of progressive experience across sales enablement, commercial operations, sales leadership, Marketing, proposal/RFP operations, or a closely related function

  • Demonstrated success building and scaling an enablement operating model, including sales rep onboarding, sales manager enablement, methodology adoption, content governance, certification, field reinforcement, and content performance measurement

  • Experience supporting complex B2G, public-sector, GovTech, public safety, or enterprise sales motions involving multiple stakeholders, non-linear procurement, RFPs, and formal approval processes

  • Proven leadership of business-to-government deal desk, proposal and/or RFP operations

  • Strong cross-functional operating experience partnering with Sales, RevOps, Marketing, Policy/Government Relations, Legal, Product, and Post-Sales to turn strategy and field feedback into adopted processes, tools, and programs

  • Fluency with Salesforce and commercial performance data, including pipeline hygiene, stage progression, KPI design, dashboards, and translating analysis into targeted interventions

  • Experience using AI and knowledge-management tools to improve research, competitive intelligence, content creation, retrieval, standardization, reuse, and productivity

  • Executive-level communication and facilitation skills, with a track record of converting ambiguity into clear priorities, owners, operating rhythms, and measurable outcomes

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent graduate degree preferred (or equivalent practical experience)

BusPatrol Value Proposition:

Who We Are

At BusPatrol, safety isn’t just a priority — it’s our mission. As the nation’s most trusted school bus stop-arm technology solution, we serve over 350 school districts, protecting nearly 2 million students across 30,000 buses. Every day, millions of children rely on school buses to get to and from school safely, yet reckless drivers continue to put them at risk.

As a technology company with a unique focus on public safety, we use cutting-edge AI, machine learning, and telematics to improve school bus safety. Our all-in-one safety program equips school bus fleets with AI-powered cameras, cloud-based data management, and an integrated software platform to capture and process stop-arm violations. Our safety programs foster accountability and reduce dangerous driving behavior in communities across the country.

By partnering with school districts, municipalities, and law enforcement, we make safety solutions more accessible and effective, ensuring that every child’s journey to and from school is as safe as possible.

What We Offer

When you join BusPatrol, you are not just taking a job. You are joining a mission-driven team dedicated to making a real impact. We offer:

✔ Competitive salary and benefits package

✔ Unlimited PTO

✔ A purpose-driven career, working to protect children and improve public safety

✔ The occasion to participate in BusPatrol’s culture of safety, learning, and teamwork

✔ A team of innovators, committed to leveraging AI and smart technology for social good

Be Part of Something Bigger

We are looking for a passionate and dedicated team member to help us make roads safer. This is a meaningful opportunity to contribute to a mission-driven company that is using technology to create real change. At BusPatrol, we foster an inclusive and diverse environment built on integrity, collaboration, and innovation. If you are ready to be part of a team that is deeply committed to safety and community impact, we would love to hear from you.

Together, we can protect students, hold drivers accountable, and build a safer future for all.

We are looking for a valued member of the BusPatrol team to assist us in our quest to improve children’s safety. This is an important role for us and a great opportunity for the right candidate. Our environment is inclusive, diverse, ignited, built on integrity, and deeply committed.

The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your Talent Partner can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location and skill level during the hiring process.

job.title: Engineering Manager, Cloud Infrastructure
job.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the Role

Replit enables people to build software with AI. The infrastructure underneath that experience must make it straightforward to launch services, isolate workloads, and run reliable systems at scale.

We're hiring a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead Cloud Infrastructure: the shared infrastructure as code (IaC), networking, storage, compute, and service mesh platforms that Replit's product and platform teams depend on. You'll lead and grow an existing engineering team building and operating these foundations, including Kubernetes, shared edge networking, service mesh and workload identity.

This is a platform-building role with production accountability. You should be comfortable going deep on a design or incident while developing a team that does not depend on you for every decision.

What You'll Do

  • Own the cloud-platform roadmap. Lead the team's IaC, networking, storage, compute, and service mesh platforms. Translate product, platform, reliability, and security needs into sequenced outcomes, balancing foundational investment, lifecycle work, and delivery commitments against the team's capacity.

  • Make infrastructure repeatable and self-service. Build maintained IaC interfaces for services, cells, connectivity, identities, and shared resources. Enable internal customer teams to provision infrastructure without bespoke coordination or dependence on individual experts.

  • Operate what the team builds. Own platform availability, upgrades, isolation, recovery, and incident remediation. Maintain clear SLOs, sustainable on-call coverage, and primary and backup owners for critical systems.

  • Stay technically engaged. Review designs and production changes, debug difficult failure modes, and use AI coding tools—including Replit—to prototype and automate. Apply rigorous review and verification to AI-generated infrastructure changes.

  • Build and grow a high-ownership engineering team. Coach engineers, develop technical leaders, set clear expectations, manage performance, and hire against agreed needs. Delegate meaningful ownership as the team grows.

What You'll Bring

  • Demonstrated engineering management. You have led and developed engineers, made prioritization and performance decisions, hired thoughtfully, and delivered through a team—not only acted as its strongest individual contributor.

  • Software-oriented infrastructure depth. You have built and operated cloud platforms or distributed systems and can reason across infrastructure code, Kubernetes, networking, service identity, and stateful dependencies.

  • Safe-change and production judgment. You have owned consequential migrations and incidents, can explain failure modes and rollback limits, and know when simplifying a system is better than adding another platform.

  • Platform-product and engineering judgment. You understand internal customers, create interfaces other teams adopt, and make clear tradeoffs among reliability, developer autonomy, engineering effort, and workload efficiency.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with multi-tenant, cellular, regional, or dedicated enterprise infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with GCP/GKE, Terraform or similar IaC systems, Cloudflare, Envoy/Istio, SPIFFE/SPIRE, and managed data services.

  • Experience with large-fleet rightsizing, infrastructure consolidation, or migrating CI compute without disrupting developer workflows.

  • A track record using AI tools to increase engineering output while preserving production safeguards.

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

Want to learn more about what we are up to?

  • Self-driving Company

  • Replit Agent at Scale

  • AI Adoption

  • Build Open-Source Apps

Interviewing + Culture at Replit

  • Operating Principles

job.title: Principal Customer Success Executive
job.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

As a trusted C-Suite / executive level advisor on ServiceNow offerings, the Principal Customer Success Executive (PCSE) owns the post-sale customer relationship, aiming to increase customer satisfaction and drive retention through Impact delivery. Principal CSEs are experienced individuals who bring a consultative, problem-solving approach to partnering with senior customer stakeholders to derive value from our platforms. They demonstrate a strong understanding of customer’s industry and specific business strategies, driving alignment between these factors and what ServiceNow can offer to enable better business outcomes for their customers. This role drives business transformation by maximizing the long-term strategic value of ServiceNow and ensuring that every aspect of the customer’s platform and capability are ready for expansion. 

They provide strategic direction and mentorship to both customers and ServiceNow teams managing complex, multi-workstream programs. They play a pivotal role in resolving escalations and mitigating risks, ensuring adoption and usage is maintained at healthy levels. Principal CSEs focus on ensuring the customer recognizes the value of the ServiceNow Platform at all levels and stages, facilitating a smooth path to both renewal and up- and cross-sell. 

Overall, Principal CSEs are responsible for fostering the relationship with C-suite level stakeholders in a smaller number of strategically important Impact accounts, with the aim of increasing customer satisfaction and driving retention and upgrades, where applicable. 

Job Responsibilities:

  • Lead high-complexity transformations in our largest and most strategic customers, ensuring all ServiceNow Customer Excellence roles align and deliver in accordance with governance frameworks, customer objectives, and organizational priorities; ultimately chaperoning Impact value management and demonstrating strategic oversight. 
  • Proactively identify professional services pipeline opportunities through product capabilities road mapping, value blueprints and adoption analysis, providing pre-sales support for funnel opportunities as requested. 
  • Partner with Impact team members (e.g., Customer Success Managers) leveraging the joint visibility of customer insights to create executive-ready narratives. 
  • Work with senior executives to shape and influence customer organizational strategy by identifying emerging trends, refining best practices, and aligning delivery approaches with evolving market demands, and providing industry-specific thought leadership. 
  • Drive operational consistency and excellence by standardizing delivery methodologies and ensuring adherence to governance and quality standards, interfacing with Delivery as required. 
  • Establish relationships with ServiceNow leaders, advocating for product evolution based on customer insights, and mentoring other Customer Success resources on transformation best practices. 
  • Identify areas of risk and take steps to prevent customer or revenue churn. 
  • Work closely with Sales Teams to define and execute product adoption and customer retention plans. 
  • Provide prescriptive guidance on internal project/program governance and help the customer create the appropriate governance models and ensure adherence. 
  • Help the customer identify incidents where contractual SLAs were missed and take necessary action. 
  • Improve overall customer satisfaction, as well as the satisfaction of their internal customers.

Qualifications

Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry. 

Significant experience collaborating with senior IT and business leaders, with a track record of successfully translating corporate strategy/objectives with the applied use of ServiceNow technology in the context of the client’s environment. 

PMP preferred; project management experience required. 

Minimum 15+ years in client-facing roles with a focus on account management, consulting, or transformation leadership. Experience in executive-level leadership roles, with a proven track record of influencing senior stakeholders and driving strategic outcomes, is strongly preferred. 

Experience in any of the following critical subject areas, with a demonstrated history delivering consulting services: 

  • IT Strategy and Planning 
  • IT Operations and Management 
  • Human Resources 
  • Security Operations 
  • Customer Service Management 
  • IT Processes 
  • IT Governance 
  • IT Portfolio, Program and Project Management 
  • IT Project Delivery (SDLC) 

Experience with project problem diagnosis, solution development, client communications, facilitation of decision making, documentation, managing client expectations, and team leadership. 

Independently leverages AI to optimize workflows, tailor customer solutions, and inform strategic decisions.  

Articulates AI system design, ethical implications, and platform use cases clearly, guiding peers and stakeholders in responsible, value-driven AI adoption.

job.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who We Are</strong></p> <p>Finance leaders choose Billtrust to get paid faster, control costs, and maximize customer satisfaction. As the leader in B2B accounts receivable workflow and payment software, we provide the world’s leading brands with AI-powered solutions across the full AR lifecycle—from invoice presentment and payment processing to cash application and collections. Across every function, our teams use AI tools daily to work faster, make better decisions, and deliver higher-quality outcomes. We hire exceptional people, give them cutting-edge AI capabilities, and measure success by the impact they create. We aspire to be the best and take pride in our work. When we fall short, we own it and come back stronger.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>The Manager, Revenue is a critical role responsible for overseeing order management and revenue operations, ensuring that customer contracts are booked accurately, revenue is recognized correctly, and the order-to-cash process runs smoothly. You will leverage AI tools and co-worker agents to automate order processing, flag revenue recognition exceptions, and accelerate month-end close, focusing your expertise on process accuracy, compliance, and team leadership.</p> <p>Reporting to the Controller, this role leads the team responsible for order management and revenue accounting, partnering closely with Sales, Legal, and FP&amp;A to ensure contracts are processed correctly and revenue is reported in compliance with ASC 606 and company policy.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <p><strong>Revenue Recognition &amp; Technical Accounting</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the organization’s subject matter expert on ASC 606, owning and maintaining the company’s formal revenue recognition policy.</li> <li>Research and document technical accounting positions and memoranda for complex, non-standard, or new revenue arrangements, ensuring conclusions are audit-ready.</li> <li>Own and evolve standalone selling price (SSP) methodologies and allocation approaches as products, pricing, and geographies expand.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Contract Review &amp; Deal Partnership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead review of complex and strategic customer contracts, determining revenue treatment and advising on deal structure before terms are finalized.</li> <li>Partner proactively with Legal, Sales, and Order Management during deal structuring to flag revenue recognition implications early, rather than only reviewing after signature.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Fluctuation Analysis &amp; Close Ownership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end monthly revenue close, including flux/variance analysis, and prepare clear explanations of revenue movement for executive and board-level audiences.</li> <li>Own deferred revenue, unbilled receivables, and contract asset/liability reconciliations, ensuring balances tie to source data and the general ledger.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Internal Controls</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, document, and continuously improve internal controls over&nbsp;&nbsp;the quote-to-cash cycle</li> <li>Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external auditors on revenue matters, owning PBC packages, walkthroughs, and audit responses.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Internal &amp; External Reporting</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prepare and review revenue-related financial statement disclosures and supporting schedules for external reporting.</li> <li>Deliver management reporting and analysis that informs decisions made by FP&amp;A, executives, and the board.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Process Automation &amp; AI Adoption</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead automation and process-transformation initiatives across the revenue close and order-to-cash cycle, building or directing the build of tools that reduce manual work.</li> <li>Maintain a working practice with AI tools (e.g., LLMs, copilots) for tasks such as contract term extraction, reconciliation matching, anomaly detection, and first-draft variance narratives, with clear judgment on where AI output still requires human review.</li> <li>Drive the strategy and roadmap for revenue-related systems improvements, partnering with Engineering/Business Systems on implementation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ERP &amp; Systems Fluency</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintain deep fluency in the company’s ERP, CRM, and revenue subledger systems (e.g., Salesforce, Intacct, Billing Platform, Certinia, or equivalent), including leading system integrations or migrations affecting revenue.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></p> <p><strong>Required Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of experience in revenue accounting, order management, or a related accounting function.</li> <li>Track record driving AI adoption across a team or function, using AI tools to automate order processing and revenue recognition workflows.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of ASC 606 revenue recognition principles and their application to SaaS or subscription contracts.</li> <li>Experience managing or leading a team of accounting or order management professionals.</li> <li>Proven ability to partner cross-functionally with Sales, Legal, and FP&amp;A.</li> <li>Strong attention to detail and a track record of managing accurate, timely month-end close processes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>CPA or progress toward CPA certification.</li> <li>Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, or subscription-based business models.</li> <li>Experience with ERP and CPQ systems.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI-powered accounting or revenue automation tools.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What You’ll Get</strong></p> <p>At Billtrust, we believe your total rewards should reflect the impact you make. Our benefits package includes comprehensive health coverage, competitive retirement, generous PTO and parental leave, flexible work options, and meaningful investment in your professional development. We’re building something special and we want you to feel supported while doing it.</p> <p>At Billtrust, we value an equitable and inclusive work environment and strive to build and foster diverse teams. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace that celebrates and supports diversity and inclusion. We make all employment and related decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.</p></div>

We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

CrowdStrike's engineering organization is scaling its use of agentic AI across the software development lifecycle — from code generation to review to testing and release. As a Sr. AI SDLC Engineer II, you'll help drive that transformation: building the platforms and workflows that let engineers ship faster, offload well-scoped work to AI agents with confidence, and spend more of their time on the hardest problems. You'll partner closely with engineering teams to identify friction points across the dev lifecycle and turn them into automated, agent-driven capabilities — with an eye toward efficient use of compute and model spend along the way.


What You'll Do:


  • Design and build agentic workflows that let engineers automate more of the SDLC — from code generation and review to testing and release — with confidence in the output.
  • Improve context-grounding systems so agents resolve the right information on the first try, cutting slow, error-prone multi-turn search out of the workflow.
  • Tune model-routing so each task runs on the model best suited to it — matching capability to the job at hand, with cost efficiency as one input among several.
  • Build observability and quality tooling — dashboards, usage insights, benchmark suites — that give engineers confidence in what agents are doing and how well they're doing it.
  • Establish internal benchmarks graded against real-world tasks (bug detection, review quality, latency) to validate improvements empirically rather than by intuition.
  • Partner closely with engineering teams to identify high-friction points in their workflows and turn them into automated, agent-driven capabilities.
  • Contribute to the broader engineering culture of responsible, effective AI adoption across the organization.

What You'll Need:


  • 5+ years of backend/platform engineering experience, ideally with production Kubernetes systems.
  • Hands-on experience building or operating LLM-agent infrastructure — harnesses, tool-integration protocols, subagent orchestration, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of LLM application mechanics: context windows, prompt design, caching, and reasoning/latency tradeoffs.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
  • Comfort working from ambiguous, evolving specs.
  • Go and/or Python proficiency.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms, observability tooling, or cost/governance dashboards.

Bonus Qualifications


  • Experience with modern AI coding agent frameworks or SDKs.
  • Familiarity with graph-based context systems (knowledge graphs, entity resolution) feeding LLM applications.
  • Background instrumenting or optimizing large-scale event pipelines.
  • Prior experience running a benchmark-driven optimization program (A/B testing, Pareto-frontier tracking) for a production system.

job.description:

About the Role:
CrowdStrike's engineering organization is scaling its use of agentic AI across the software development lifecycle — from code generation to review to testing and release. As an AI SDLC Engineer, you'll help drive that transformation: building the platforms and workflows that let engineers ship faster, offload well-scoped work to AI agents with confidence, and spend more of their time on the hardest problems. You'll partner closely with engineering teams to identify friction points across the dev lifecycle and turn them into automated, agent-driven capabilities — with an eye toward efficient use of compute and model spend along the way.


What You'll Do:


  • Design and build agentic workflows that let engineers automate more of the SDLC — from code generation and review to testing and release — with confidence in the output.
  • Improve context-grounding systems so agents resolve the right information on the first try, cutting slow, error-prone multi-turn search out of the workflow.
  • Tune model-routing so each task runs on the model best suited to it — matching capability to the job at hand, with cost efficiency as one input among several.
  • Build observability and quality tooling — dashboards, usage insights, benchmark suites — that give engineers confidence in what agents are doing and how well they're doing it.
  • Establish internal benchmarks graded against real-world tasks (bug detection, review quality, latency) to validate improvements empirically rather than by intuition.
  • Partner closely with engineering teams to identify high-friction points in their workflows and turn them into automated, agent-driven capabilities.
  • Contribute to the broader engineering culture of responsible, effective AI adoption across the organization.

What You'll Need:


  • 5+ years of backend/platform engineering experience, ideally with production Kubernetes systems.
  • Hands-on experience building or operating LLM-agent infrastructure — harnesses, tool-integration protocols, subagent orchestration, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of LLM application mechanics: context windows, prompt design, caching, and reasoning/latency tradeoffs.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
  • Comfort working from ambiguous, evolving specs.
  • Go and/or Python proficiency.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms, observability tooling, or cost/governance dashboards.

  • Experience with modern AI coding agent frameworks or SDKs.
  • Familiarity with graph-based context systems (knowledge graphs, entity resolution) feeding LLM applications.
  • Background instrumenting or optimizing large-scale event pipelines.

job.title: Client Principal - AI Consulting (energy, Oil & Gas)
job.description:
At CloudFactory, we are a mission-driven team passionate about unlocking the potential of AI to transform the world. By combining advanced technology with a global network of talented people, we make unusable data usable, driving real-world impact at scale. 

More than just a workplace, we’re a global community founded on strong relationships and the belief that meaningful work transforms lives. Our commitment to earning, learning, and serving fuels everything we do as we strive to connect one million people to meaningful work and build leaders worth following.

Our Culture

At CloudFactory, we believe in building a workplace where everyone feels empowered, valued, and inspired to bring their authentic selves to work. We are:

  • Mission-Driven: We focus on creating economic and social impact.
  • People-Centric: We care deeply about our team’s growth, well-being, and sense of belonging.
  • Innovative: We embrace change and find better ways to do things together.
  • Globally Connected: We foster collaboration between diverse cultures and perspectives.

If you’re passionate about innovation, collaboration, and making a real impact, we’d love to have you on board!

About the Role

Energy, Oil & Gas is one of the most operationally complex and asset-intensive industries, where AI is rapidly moving from experimentation to enterprise-scale deployment.
While the opportunity is significant, many organizations struggle to move from promising pilots to production-grade AI due to fragmented data, complex environments, and strict safety and regulatory requirements.

CloudFactory is built to solve exactly this.

As Client Principal, AI Consulting (Energy, Oil & Gas), you will be the senior commercial and strategic leader for our energy sector. You will operate as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders across operators, oilfield services companies, and energy enterprises, shaping AI transformation agendas and leading engagements from origination through delivery oversight.

This is a high-impact, externally facing role for someone who can open doors, lead complex conversations, and convert opportunity into long-term partnerships.

What You’ll Do

Executive Relationships & Strategic Advisory

  • Build and lead market growth strategy across energy operators, oilfield services companies, and energy enterprises.
  • Operate as a strategic advisor on AI adoption, from identifying high-value use cases to scaling solutions in production.
  • Engage C-suite and VP stakeholders as a trusted advisor, not a vendor.
  • Navigate complex stakeholder environments across operations, subsurface, engineering, HSE, IT, and data teams.
  • Develop a deep understanding of client priorities across upstream, midstream, and downstream operations.

Business Development & Growth

  • Own new client acquisition, account expansion and P/L management accounts within the energy sector.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans with clear pathways from pilot to enterprise-scale programs.
  • Lead consultative, executive-level sales conversations and build compelling business cases for AI investment.
  • Own the full commercial lifecycle: discovery, solution framing, proposal development, and executive presentations.
  • Navigate sector-specific buying cycles, procurement processes, and capital planning timelines.

Solution Shaping & Delivery Oversight

  • Identify and shape high-impact AI use cases, including:
    • Predictive maintenance and asset monitoring
    • Computer vision for inspection (drone, aerial, and field imagery)
    • Safety and compliance automation
    • Intelligent document processing from engineering documentation
    • Geospatial, LiDAR, and digital twin data pipelines
  • Translate operational challenges into scalable AI solutions leveraging CloudFactory’s capabilities.
  • Partner closely with technical and delivery teams to ensure high-quality execution and client satisfaction.
  • Oversee delivery to ensure alignment on scope, timelines, and outcomes.

Thought Leadership & Industry Impact

  • Stay at the forefront of AI trends across the energy value chain, including asset digitization, predictive operations, and computer vision at scale.
  • Contribute to CloudFactory’s external presence through industry events, client engagements, and thought leadership.
  • Bring sector insights into product, delivery, and go-to-market strategy.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Lead and inspire cross-functional teams including consultants, data scientists, and engineers.
  • Foster strong collaboration between client stakeholders and internal teams.
  • Promote best practices in AI consulting, delivery excellence, and client engagement.

Requirements

  • Deep industry expertise in energy, oil & gas, or adjacent industrial sectors, with a strong understanding of operations and digital transformation.
  • Established executive network across energy operators or oilfield services companies that you can activate from day one.
  • Strong business acumen, with the ability to translate operational challenges into AI-driven opportunities; P/L management experience.
  • Technical fluency in AI/ML concepts, including predictive analytics and computer vision.
  • Proven consulting and commercial experience, managing enterprise clients and complex engagements.
  • Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders as a trusted peer.
  • Leadership experience, guiding cross-functional teams and delivering high-impact outcomes.
  • Experience: 10+ years of experience in consulting, technology, or digital transformation within energy or industrial sectors.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, statistics, or related field. Advanced degrees in AI, data science, or business are a plus.

Why This Role

This is an opportunity to operate at the intersection of AI, industry transformation, and executive leadership, helping some of the world’s largest energy companies unlock real value from AI. You’ll play a critical role in shaping both client outcomes and CloudFactory’s growth in a strategically important sector.

Benefits

  • Compensation: Highly competitive base salary and an aggressive, performance-aligned incentive compensation structure.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Robust health, dental, vision, and retirement plans.
  • Cutting-Edge Projects: Direct exposure to, and leadership of, advanced AI initiatives with the world's most influential energy corporations.
  • Collaborative Culture: A supportive, high-performance team environment focused on innovation and measurable client success.
  • Professional Growth: Structured access to continuous executive education, mentorship, and accelerated leadership development opportunities.
  • Executive Visibility: Regular interaction with, and direct accountability to, the company’s senior leadership team.

This role represents a unique, high-impact opportunity to define and shape the AI landscape for major global corporations in the energy sector. If you are a highly consultative professional with deep sector knowledge, a passion for AI, and a proven talent for originating and closing complex, strategic enterprise deals, we encourage your application.

job.title: Distinguished Engineer  AI & Engineering Transformation
job.description:
Company Description

Acumatica is a company on a mission. We are a leading innovator in cloud ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) solutions with growing businesses worldwide. But don’t take our word for it—read what analysts like G2, IDC, Nucleus Research, and Info-Tech have to say about us. Acumatica is different by design and purposely built to help small and midsized companies thrive in today’s digital economy. Our industry-specific business management solution is engineered to address real-world needs—featuring intelligent workflows and market-leading usability that enable companies to manage risk, anticipate disruption, and seize new opportunities. Our principled business practices, growth-friendly licensing, and flexible deployment options put organizations in control of their own future. Acumatica is more than just a product—we are a community of partners, customers, and creators committed to elevating business performance. Our ecosystem is driven by collaboration, merging leading technology and real-world insights to put organizations control of their future. In May of 2025, Acumatica was acquired by Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm focused on enterprise software, data and technology-enabled businesses.

Acumatica’s culture is collaborative and high-energy. We are passionate about our product and our mission, and we are loyal to each other and our company. We value work/life balance, efficiency, simplicity, freakishly friendly customer service, and making a difference in the world. Acumatica offers exceptional professional and financial growth potential. To learn more about Acumatica’s mission, please visit: http://www.acumatica.com.

Job Description

Acumatica is seeking a highly influential technical leader to help lead Acumatica’s next phase of transformation in the AI era. This role is ideal for a distinguished technologist who combines deep technical expertise with strategic thinking, strong execution capabilities, and the ability to influence across teams and organizations. 

As a Distinguished Engineer/Architect reporting to the Chief Engineering Officer you will lead enterprise-wide transformation initiatives across AI-enabled product innovation and engineering productivity. You will work closely with platform, AI/ML, product, and application engineering leaders to accelerate adoption of AI capabilities across the company and shape how Acumatica builds and delivers software in the AI era. 

This is an individual contributor leadership role with broad organizational influence. Success in this role requires the ability to lead through technical credibility, collaboration, coaching, and execution rather than formal authority. The ideal candidate combines long-term strategic thinking with a pragmatic, hands-on approach to driving measurable outcomes. 

Key Areas of Impact 

AI Transformation 

Drive the adoption of AI across Acumatica’s products and workflows to help customers achieve better outcomes faster. 

  • Partner with AI/ML, platform, product, and application teams to define and scale AI-powered product capabilities. 
  • Guide application teams in leveraging Acumatica’s AI building blocks, orchestration infrastructure, and platform services to deliver intelligent, agentic customer experiences.
  • Influence application architecture, design patterns, and engineering practices required for scalable AI adoption.
  • Help identify and deliver high-impact customer scenarios where AI can deliver measurable business value through automation, insights, and workflow acceleration.

Productivity Transformation 

Help transform Acumatica’s engineering lifecycle through effective adoption of modern AI-assisted development practices. 

  • Stay at the forefront of industry trends, tooling, and best practices in AI-enabled software development. 
  • Identify opportunities to improve productivity, engineering quality, and delivery efficiency using AI. 
  • Drive adoption of modern engineering practices across BA, development, and QA teams. 
  • Partner with engineering leaders to evolve how software is designed, built, tested, and maintained at scale.

Additional Responsibilities 

  • Define and influence long-term AI and engineering transformation strategy across the company. 
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends, and competitive movements to help shape Acumatica’s technical direction and investment priorities. 
  • Collaborate with product and engineering leadership to align technical strategy with customer and business priorities. 
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance, architectural leadership, and mentorship across teams. 
  • Lead through influence by aligning stakeholders, building consensus, and driving execution across organizational boundaries. 
  • Represent Acumatica externally with customers, partners, analysts, and at industry events and conferences.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related field. Advanced degree (MS or PhD) is a plus. 
  • 15+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience leading large-scale technical initiatives in SaaS or cloud-based enterprise software environments.

job.title: Principal Customer Success Executive, U.s. Federal
job.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

As a trusted C-Suite / senior executive level advisor on ServiceNow offerings, the Principal Customer Success Executive (PCSE) owns the post-sale customer relationship, aiming to increase customer satisfaction and drive retention through Impact delivery. Principal CSEs are experienced individuals who bring a consultative, problem-solving approach to partnering with senior customer stakeholders to derive value from our platforms. They demonstrate a strong understanding of customer’s industry and specific business strategies, driving alignment between these factors and what ServiceNow can offer to enable better business outcomes for their customers. This role drives business transformation by maximizing the long-term strategic value of ServiceNow and ensuring that every aspect of the customer’s platform and capability are ready for expansion.  

They provide strategic direction and mentorship to both customers and ServiceNow teams managing complex, multi-workstream programs. They play a pivotal role in resolving escalations and mitigating risks, ensuring adoption and usage is maintained at healthy levels. Principal CSEs focus on ensuring the customer recognizes the value of the ServiceNow Platform at all levels and stages, facilitating a smooth path to both renewal and up- and cross-sell.  

Overall, Principal CSEs are responsible for fostering the relationship with C-suite level stakeholders in a smaller number of strategically important Impact accounts, with the aim of increasing customer satisfaction and driving retention and upgrades, where applicable.  

 What You Get to Do in This Role: 

  • Lead high-complexity transformations in our largest and most strategic customers, ensuring all ServiceNow Customer Excellence roles align and deliver in accordance with governance frameworks, customer objectives, and organizational priorities; ultimately chaperoning Impact value management and demonstrating strategic oversight.  
  • Proactively identify professional services pipeline opportunities through product capabilities road mapping, value blueprints and adoption analysis, providing pre-sales support for funnel opportunities as requested.  
  • Partner with Impact team members (e.g., Customer Success Managers or other Customer Success Executives) leveraging the joint visibility of customer insights to create executive-ready narratives and platform value stories.  
  • Work with senior executives to shape and influence customer organizational strategy by identifying emerging trends, refining best practices, aligning delivery approaches with evolving market demands, and providing industry-specific thought leadership.  
  • Drive operational consistency and excellence by standardizing delivery methodologies and ensuring adherence to governance and quality standards, interfacing with Delivery as required. Advise on change management plans to support strong post-delivery adoption. 
  • Establish relationships with ServiceNow leaders, advocating for product evolution based on customer insights, and mentoring other Customer Success resources on transformation best practices.  
  • Identify areas of risk and take steps to prevent customer or revenue churn.  
  • Work closely with Sales Teams to define and execute product adoption and customer retention plans.  
  • Provide prescriptive guidance on internal project/program governance and help the customer create the appropriate governance models and ensure adherence.  
  • Help the customer identify incidents where contractual SLAs were missed and take necessary action.  
  • Improve overall customer satisfaction, as well as the satisfaction of their internal customers. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.  
  • Significant experience collaborating with senior IT and business leaders, with a track record of successfully translating corporate strategy/objectives with the applied use of ServiceNow technology in the context of the client’s environment.  
  • PMP preferred; project management experience required.  
  • Minimum 15+ years in client-facing roles with a focus on account management, consulting, or transformation leadership throughout all phases. Experience in executive-level leadership roles, with a proven track record of influencing senior stakeholders and driving strategic outcomes, is strongly preferred.  
  • Experience supporting or working with U.S. Federal customers preferred
  • Experience in any of the following critical subject areas, with a demonstrated history delivering consulting services:  
    • IT Strategy and Planning  
    • IT Operations and Management  
    • Human Resources  
    • Security Operations  
    • Customer Service Management  
    • IT Processes  
    • IT Governance  
    • IT Portfolio, Program and Project Management  
    • IT Project Delivery (SDLC) and adoption 
  • Experience with project problem diagnosis, solution development, client communications, facilitation of decision making, documentation, managing client expectations, and team leadership.  
  • Independently leverages AI to optimize workflows, tailor customer solutions, and inform strategic decisions.   
  • Articulates AI system design, ethical implications, and platform use cases clearly, guiding peers and stakeholders in responsible, value-driven AI adoption.  

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $180,200 - $281,600, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity,  veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.  

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance. 

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

job.description:
About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

Docker Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) embed directly with our most strategic customers to solve important, complex technical problems and turn ambitious ideas into production outcomes. FDEs take on the most challenging technical challenges using existing Docker products and patterns when possible, and work across customer, Docker Product and Engineering teams to realize new approaches when required.

As a Docker FDE, you will work side-by-side with customer engineering teams to deeply understand their goals, problems, constraints, and technical landscape; identify the highest-leverage opportunities; and design, build, and ship solutions with them. You own the technical journey from discovery and architecture through prototyping, implementation and production rollout.

The solutions you build may use existing Docker products, extend Docker into new environments, integrate deeply with customer and third-party systems, or reveal capabilities that Docker should build next. You work closely with Docker Solutions Architects to evolve existing patterns, and Docker Product and Engineering to turn new learnings into reusable patterns and product capabilities.

Responsibilities

Build in Production with Customers

  • Embed with customer engineering teams to design, build, and ship solutions from first prototype through stable production rollout. Use existing Docker products and patterns when possible, invent, prototype and validate innovative solutions when necessary.

  • Deliver working technical artifacts to customers: custom MCP servers with tightly integrated Docker Sandbox environments for coding agents and containerized agents; Docker Compose definitions for multi-agent harnesses and model-backed applications; Hardened Image standardization and migration; New tools that unblock customer progress.

  • Integrate Docker's AI platform with the customer's existing stack, including identity providers (OIDC/SAML/SSO), secrets management, private and air-gapped registries, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling.

  • Own technical delivery on your engagements: scope the work, sequence it, make trade-offs between speed and quality, remove blockers early, and contribute directly to code whenever progress depends on it.

Make AI Adoption Safe and Governable

  • Translate customer security, compliance, and platform requirements into concrete plans and see those plans through from ideation to production.

  • Help customers define controls to enable them to adopt agentic AI to solve their unique business problems without compromising security, compliance, data sovereignty or end-user experience.

  • Establish quality and performance standards for customers and work closely with Docker Product and Engineering to quickly address issues that fall outside of established thresholds

  • Partner with customer security and platform teams to get agentic workloads through architecture review, threat modeling, and change control.

Partner with Solutions Architecture and the Field

  • Work closely with Solutions Architects to enable off-the-self solutions when possible and provide technical experience and leadership when a bespoke solution is necessary.

  • Feed implementation learnings back into reference architectures, SOW templates, and success patterns so that FDE innovations become standard features and implementation patterns.

  • Support the field with technical depth during proofs of concept, escalations, and expansion conversations when a working build is the fastest path to a customer adoption.

Close the Loop with Product and Engineering

  • As part of Docker Engineering FDEs work closely with Product and Engineering teams to fold FDE innovations, learnings, and design patterns into existing or new products and services.

  • Work with Customers, Product and Engineering to establish quality and performance thresholds, ensuring customer environments meet them consistently, and responding quickly and decisively when they don’t.

  • Be the voice of the customer. Deliver data-driven and actionable feedback to Product and Engineering: what works well; what does not; what customers are asking for; and what blocks their adoption and forward progress. FDE experience directly influences the roadmap.

Shape the Practice

  • Define the FDE engagement model, delivery standards, and quality bar, and codify them so that engagements are consistent across customers, regions, and delivery partners.

  • Mentor and lead other Forward Deployed Engineers, and participate in hiring loops to grow the team.

  • Act as the senior technical escalation point on the hardest problems impacting your customers. Every incident is an opportunity to improve Docker products and services.

  • Maintain deep, current knowledge of the agentic AI stack: LLMs, APIs, MCP, coding agents, model and harness evaluation approaches, performance and quality thresholds, deployment patterns.

  • This role may require participation in an on-call rotation to provide support outside of standard business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as needed.

Qualifications

Required

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Professional Services Engineer, or Software Engineer with consulting or technical founder experience.

  • Technical leadership across multiple engagements, teams, or domains, with a proven ability to set delivery standards, define repeatable patterns, and influence product direction through field evidence.

  • Expert production coding skills in Go, Python, or TypeScript, with a track record of shipping and operating software that other people depend on and of leading technical design reviews.

  • Deep, hands-on Docker expertise: Dockerfiles and multi-stage builds, Docker Compose, image and registry operations, container networking and storage, and container security fundamentals.

  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agents in production, including tool use and function calling, the Model Context Protocol (MCP server and client implementation), prompt and context engineering, and evaluation of agent behavior.

  • Working knowledge of software supply chain security: SBOMs, image signing and attestation, vulnerability management, minimal and hardened base images, and secure CI/CD.

  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems: identity providers (Okta, Entra ID, LDAP/Active Directory), federated identity protocols (OIDC, SAML), secrets managers, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Ability to scope and deliver complex work in ambiguous, fast-moving customer environments, making sound trade-offs between scope, speed, and quality.

  • Excellent communication skills with engineers, security and platform teams, and executive stakeholders, with a low-ego, collaborative approach and the ability to lead through influence rather than authority.

  • Proven track record of technical mentorship and of raising the bar for the engineers around you.

  • High agency and comfort operating autonomously in distributed, remote-first teams.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Travel to customer sites to build in person with customer teams, estimated at up to 50%.

Bonus

  • Experience with Docker Hardened Images, Docker Scout, MCP Gateway, MCP Toolkit, Docker Sandboxes, or Docker Model Runner.

  • Experience deploying and operating coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, or similar) in team or enterprise settings.

  • Experience with air-gapped, regulated, or compliance-driven environments in financial services, healthcare, government, or similar sectors.

  • Contributions to open source projects in the container, Kubernetes, or MCP ecosystems.

  • Prior experience founding or scaling a Forward Deployed Engineering or Professional Services practice.

Docker considers visa sponsorship on a case-by-case basis based on business needs.

Compensation & Equity

United States: $198K – $319K + equity

______________________________________________________________________

Posting Information

  • Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

  • AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

  • Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________

Perks & Benefits

  • Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

  • Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.

  • Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

  • Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.

  • Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.

  • Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.

  • Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.

  • Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.

  • Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.

  • Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.

Docker is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better products, make better decisions, and better serve our global community.

#LI-REMOTE

job.description:
Job Title:

Senior Business Intelligence Analyst

Job Description

Join our award-winning One Concentrix team as a BI Analyst supporting one of the world's most innovative AI-native technology companies. This role operates at the intersection of AI, customer outcomes, partner performance, and business transformation in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where speed, ownership, and execution matter.


ABOUT CONCENTRIX


At Concentrix, we help the world's best brands build exceptional customer experiences through innovative technology, operational excellence, and human-centered solutions. As organizations accelerate adoption of AI, automation, cloud technologies, and digital transformation initiatives, Concentrix partners with clients and strategic ecosystem partners to deliver measurable business outcomes at scale.


We are seeking a BI Analyst to drive the help successful delivery, adoption, and expansion of partner-led AI solutions while ensuring customers achieve meaningful business value and long-term success.


Success in this role requires comfort operating in a highly dynamic, rapidly evolving environment where priorities shift quickly, new challenges emerge daily, and ambiguity is often present. The ideal candidate thrives in an AI-native culture, demonstrates strong initiative, embraces continuous learning, and can quickly evaluate information, make sound decisions, and drive execution without waiting for direction.


Strategic Sales Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted analytical partner and extension of SMB Sales leadership, providing an independent, data-informed point of view.
  • Translate data into clear recommendations that influence sales strategy, prioritization, resource allocation and frontline execution.
  • Support Sales leadership with planning, forecasting, pipeline reviews, performance management and strategic decision-making.

Commercial and Action-Oriented Analytics

  • Identify where the business is winning, losing, accelerating, stalling or underperforming.
  • Segment performance across markets, customer groups, industries, products, channels, sellers, partners, funnel stages and opportunities.
  • Move beyond reporting what happened to determine why it happened, what it means commercially and what Sales should do next.
  • Identify emerging trends, risks, execution gaps and growth opportunities before they become visible through standard reporting.
  • Develop and test hypotheses, challenge assumptions and proactively investigate areas of business opportunity or risk.

Client and Stakeholder Management

  • Partner directly with Sales leaders, clients, operational teams and cross-functional stakeholders to clarify objectives and define the appropriate analytical approach.
  • Manage client communication and expectations across competing priorities, changing requirements and evolving business needs.
  • Communicate complex analytical findings simply and confidently to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Move comfortably between detailed analysis and high-level commercial discussions.

AI-Native Analytics and Automation

  • Use advanced AI capabilities, to structure ambiguous business problems, analyze information, generate hypotheses and accelerate insight development.
  • Use AI coding tools to support SQL development, automate repetitive analysis, build lightweight tools and improve data workflows.
  • Apply AI-assisted methods to structured and unstructured information, including qualitative feedback, conversation outputs and operational notes, when appropriate.
  • Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting, data preparation and analytical workflows.
  • Validate AI-generated outputs and maintain strong standards for analytical accuracy, confidentiality, data integrity and responsible AI use.

Independent Work in an Ambiguous Environment

  • Operate effectively in a fast-moving, startup-like environment where processes, systems, requirements and success measures may not be fully defined.
  • Create structure from incomplete information and independently determine a practical path forward.
  • Demonstrate curiosity and creativity by exploring data, asking strong questions and proposing new approaches to business problems.
  • Prioritize quickly, balance speed with analytical rigor and adapt as business needs evolve.
  • Take ownership from problem definition through analysis, recommendation, stakeholder alignment and follow-through.

Expanded Data and BI Expectations

  • Work with structured and unstructured information from multiple sources and clearly communicate data limitations, assumptions and quality gaps.
  • Develop dashboards and decision-support tools that allow Sales leaders to quickly understand performance and determine the required action.
  • Apply appropriate statistical methods to evaluate segmentation, trends, variation and performance relationships.
  • Move recurring reporting toward more diagnostic, predictive and action-oriented insights.
  • Maintain the consistency, accuracy and reliability of reporting, business metrics and underlying data.

Stronger Senior-Level Qualifications

  • Require 5+ years of experience in business intelligence, sales analytics, business analytics, revenue operations, sales strategy or a related analytical role.
  • Demonstrate success turning data into commercial insights and practical business recommendations, rather than primarily producing reports.
  • Bring practical knowledge of B2B or SMB sales motions, including pipeline management, acquisition, activation, conversion, adoption, retention and growth.
  • Demonstrate experience partnering directly with Sales leaders or client stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
  • Communicate executive-ready insights and influence senior stakeholders through clear, concise business narratives.

Preferred Experience Added

  • Experience in software, SaaS, technology, partner-led sales or another complex B2B commercial environment.
  • Hands-on experience using AI platforms in analytical work.
  • Experience automating recurring analysis, prototyping lightweight analytical tools or improving data workflows.
  • Experience combining quantitative data with qualitative or unstructured information to identify themes, sentiment or knowledge gaps.
  • Experience establishing reporting, decision frameworks and operating rhythms in a build-and-run environment.
  • Familiarity with revenue operations, sales plays, partner performance, adoption, activation and campaign-effectiveness analytics.

The salary for this position is $92,000-100,000 Annually, plus bonus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program (EAP), 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays, and paid training days.


WHY JOIN CONCENTRIX


At Concentrix, you'll help shape the future of AI-powered customer experiences while partnering with one of the world's leading AI-native organizations. You'll operate in a fast-moving environment where AI is embedded into daily workflows, decisions are made quickly, ownership is expected, and innovation is constant. This role offers the opportunity to directly influence customer success, partner performance, AI adoption, and business outcomes at scale.


Finalists should expect to participate in a live, unscripted walkthrough of an actual deliverable, workflow, or solution they personally created using an LLM. This discussion will focus on the business problem addressed, implementation approach, prompt refinement, limitations encountered, lessons learned, and measurable business impact. Prepared demonstrations or hypothetical examples are not preferred.


JOB AVAILABILITY  

This position is for an existing, immediate vacancy. We are currently seeking to fill this role with an individual who can start as soon as possible.  The deadline to apply for this position is: 10/1/26

job.title: Partner Technical Architect
job.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

ServiceNow is seeking a Partner Technology Architect to serve as the primary strategic interface for our Global and Strategic Regional partners. In this role, you will drive holistic partner growth through pre-sales technical excellence, business development, solution strategy, and AI-first technology adoption. You will combine trusted advisory relationships with partner executives, industry-aligned solution architecture, and go-to-market leadership into a single accountable role — translating platform capabilities, AI innovation, and industry context into repeatable, outcome-driven offerings that partners can build, scale, and monetize.

While this role expands into strategic business development and co-innovation, pre-sales technical excellence remains the primary operational foundation — including technical discovery, solution demonstrations, proof-of-concept leadership, and architectural validation that accelerates partner-led customer engagements.

What You’ll Do

As a Partner Technology Architect, you will serve as the dedicated strategic counterpart for assigned partner organizations, owning the full spectrum from pre-sales technical engagement through strategic co-innovation and business growth advisory.

Partner Strategy & Business Development

  • Serve as the primary strategic interface for assigned partners, building trusted relationships with partner executives and practice leaders.
  • Lead joint business planning to align partner investments, industry focus, and go-to-market priorities across all routes to market.
  • Advise partners on practice growth, specialization strategy, and readiness for AI-enabled offerings.
  • Influence partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline through offer-led strategy and solution differentiation.

Pre-Sales Excellence & Solution Strategy

  • Lead and support technical discovery sessions, executive briefings, and solution demonstrations that articulate platform value and accelerate partner-led deal velocity.
  • Drive solution strategy, helping partners align offerings to high-value industry workflows and customer outcomes.
  • Translate platform and AI capabilities into partner-differentiated, scalable solutions at the conceptual and architectural level.
  • Maintain strong workflow fluency across enterprise domains including CRM, IT, Security, and Business Services.
  • Design and execute partner-led proofs of concept and co-demonstrations that prove business value, technical feasibility, and competitive differentiation.
  • Provide technical escalation support for critical partner-led opportunities, ensuring partners have access to deep expertise at key deal milestones.

AI-First Innovation & Co-Creation

  • Champion AI-first solution design, including intelligent workflows, automation, and agent-based use cases.
  • Orchestrate partner engagement with Partner Solution Architects and domain-specialist advisors (AI, CRM, Security & Risk) to accelerate solution development.
  • Ensure partner offerings progress from concept through validation to scalable commercialization.
  • Promote responsible, enterprise-ready AI adoption aligned to governance and trust standards.

Value Engineering & Orchestration

  • Connect solution strategy to measurable business outcomes including efficiency, growth, ROI, and time-to-value.
  • Support executive-level conversations with clear value narratives and outcome-based storytelling.
  • Coordinate across internal specialist teams to deliver a unified partner experience, not fragmented touchpoints.

Qualifications

What you need to be successful in this role:

  • 8+ years of experience in pre-sales solution consulting, partner strategy, enterprise technology advisory, or related roles with proven success leading technical discovery, demonstrations, and partner engagements.
